note: Set A correctly identifies beam sections (e.g., B1 as W10X15) and opening types, while Set B misidentifies sections for B1 (claims W8X13) and E6 (claims W10X15) and confuses opening shapes (claims 8" length for E6 round holes). Set B also misattributes dimensions between Grid 3 and 4 beams (e.g., claiming 5'-0" for Grid 4). Set A has minor errors regarding a 2'-6" dimension on Grid 4 and attribute naming, but is significantly more accurate.
